description: This file implements the main game screen for a chess frontend in Flutter, including UI layout, game state management, move handling, and stub placeholders for features like AI and online play.

classes.name: GameMode
classes.description: Enumeration defining the game modes: local, AI, and online.

classes.name: GameScreenArgs
classes.description: Class used to pass arguments (game mode) to the GameScreen widget.

classes.name: GameScreen
classes.description: Main stateful widget representing the chess game screen with UI components.

methods.name: _GameScreenState.build
methods.description: Builds the UI for the game screen, including the chess board, side panel, and app bar.

methods.name: _GameScreenState._openMoves
methods.description: Displays the move history in a bottom sheet.

methods.name: _GameScreenState._showStub
methods.description: Shows a stub dialog for unimplemented features.

methods.name: _GameScreenState._handleTap
methods.description: Handles tap events on chessboard squares, including selection and move execution.

methods.name: _GameScreenState._isWhitePiece
methods.description: Determines if a piece is white based on Unicode codepoint.

methods.name: _GameScreenState._initialBoard
methods.description: Initial setup of the chessboard with starting positions.
